description: Codex: Orks (11e) 'ERE WE GO (Green Tide, 1 CP) through the real unit_selected_to_move window. Ruling: in the Movement phase it is offered only when the unit is selected for an ADVANCE move (its +2 modifies advance rolls). The player clicks the Boyz (+ attached Warboss): the default normal move opens NO window. Picking Advance + Confirm Movement Mode re-selects the unit for an advance move: the window opens before the advance roll, with an enabled 'Use on Boyz + Warboss' button. A real click on Use spends 1 CP and flags the Boyz and the Warboss; the advance is then rolled (Command Re-roll prompt: Keep Roll) and the cap is M6 + D6 + 2, the modifier shown in the dice log. The mob advances 4" west (Ctrl+A group drag) and the move is locked in. Setup-only privileges: the fixture's Ork detachment is flipped to Green Tide (stratagems reloaded) and Custodian Guard A is moved out of engagement with the Boyz so they can advance. The advance roll is then made straight away: the Boyz were the target of 'ERE WE GO this phase, so (15.01) no Command Re-roll prompt is offered for that roll (EWG-1). WP-O34 (11e Waaagh! army rule): the advance roll now pauses on the Waaagh! FREE advance re-roll (no CP, not a stratagem, so 15.01 does not bar it) — the scenario keeps the roll.

steps.comment: setup privilege: Green Tide detachment; Custodian Guard A moved 7" south, out of engagement
normal move: 'ERE WE GO is not offered. WP-O6: the attached Warboss's codex Intimidating Motivation ('at the start or end of this unit's move') is the only offer in the window
WP-O6: decline Intimidating Motivation — not under test
the advance is not rolled while the window waits
WP-O34: the Command Re-roll stratagem is still not offered (EWG-1, 15.01) — the dialog that opens is the Waaagh! army rule's FREE advance re-roll (not a stratagem, no CP)
EWG-1 (15.01): U_BOYZ_B was just the target of 'ERE WE GO this phase, so the Command Re-roll stratagem cannot target it — no re-roll prompt for its advance roll
the mode lock deferred while the window waited landed after the resume
EWG-2: the game log shows the die as rolled plus the +2 ('rolled [N] +2 ('ERE WE GO) = N+2'), not a die glyph for the modified value
